notes: The county clerk's 'Precinct Results Report' of the official results, precinct by precinct, as the State Board of Elections publishes it. Read with ballot/a build step's reader: every page read, every precinct named once, every contest's candidates adding up to its cast votes. Write-ins counted for no declared write-in candidate are left out, as the certified results leave them out.

The county clerk's 'Cumulative Results Report' of the official results (the county's totals; the Board's copy for this county gives no precincts), as the State Board of Elections publishes it. Read with ballot/a build step's reader: every page read, every precinct named once, every contest's candidates adding up to its cast votes. Write-ins counted for no declared write-in candidate are left out, as the certified results leave them out.

The Secretary of State's county-by-county results, as the State Board of Elections publishes them on its results page for the year: one section a contest, a row for each county it reaches and a Total Votes row. Every section stored here was read only because each of its columns adds up to its Total Votes row and each county is printed once in it. Saved by ballot/a build step on 2026-10-03.
